description: Use this when a visitor asks for current posted ride waits or operating status at one supported park. Resolve the park ID first. Waits older than 30 minutes are unavailable, not current; this tool does not predict future waits.

park_id.description: Canonical Parky park ID from parky_find_experience.

ride_id.description: Optional canonical ride ID to return one ride only.

name: parky_get_waits
title: Get current posted waits at a Parky park
